name: Daniella Whitmore
source:
"Has had it tough. She hides her violent past behind her piercings, bitchy attitude and goth outfits. She works as a night club dancer to pay her college bills. She is extremely intelligent, strong willed and a lover of the outer space. However, her life circumstances always kept her from walking towards her own destiny.
Her father is a gambling addicted drunk most of the times. She looks after him even though he used to abuse her as a child. Her mother lives in a mental institute. Dani, as she's known, is a foster parent's child.
Her real parents and their story are unknown."

[In-game description]
